items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 10:1
items.html: The lights of Chaya and Yechida of the direct light, which could not enter the vessels of the head because of the screen that ascended to the place of the openings of the eyes, they encircled around the NHY of AK. And see above, answer 262, concerning the second Makifim. (Item 3).
